people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.
translations.bsb: Now the Jewish Passover was near, and many people went up from the country to Jerusalem to purify themselves before the Passover.
translations.kjv: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
translations.asv: Now the passover of the Jews was at hand: and many went up to Jerusalem out of the country before the passover, to purify themselves.
